name: agent_teams_workflow_propose
description: Save a proposal for human preview. Does not apply changes or approve checkpoints.

base.description: Copy base exactly from the latest agent_teams_workflow_context result.

operations.description: One atomic batch of 1–50 proposed edits. Submit objects directly, not a JSON-encoded string. No changes take effect before human confirmation.

id.description: Existing task ID for task edits/removal/rerun, or checkpoint ID for rework. Optional new ID for add_task.

name.description: Required for member operations; use the exact member name.

layers.description: Pass a JSON object directly, never a JSON-encoded string, array, null or empty string. general and specific are objects; their requirements, deliverables and acceptance fields are strings. Generate both layers when creating tasks: general is the reusable method and quality constraints; specific is the COMPLETE standalone execution contract, concretizing every general method, deliverable and acceptance constraint for the current goal, paths and parameters. Executors see only specific, never general; do not refer back to general. Do not duplicate layers in description. Omit layers entirely when making an unrelated edit.

deliverables.description: Plain text, not an array. Separate multiple deliverables with newlines.

acceptance.description: Plain text, not an array. Separate multiple acceptance criteria with newlines.

deliverables.description: Plain text, not an array. Separate multiple deliverables with newlines.

acceptance.description: Plain text, not an array. Separate multiple acceptance criteria with newlines.

instructions.description: Required non-empty new requirements for rerun_task and rework.

dependencies.description: Required for add_task; use [] for no prerequisites. For update_task omit to keep existing dependencies.

taskIds.description: Required upstream task IDs for rework.
